title: Taiwan CPI, DGBAS
description: CPI for Taiwan: all items, DGBAS core, goods, services, energy, the seven groups and main subgroups, income groups and elderly households; index (2021 = 100), m/m, y/y and DGBAS seasonally adjusted index and m/m, as published by DGBAS, from 1960; plus food and non-alcoholic beverages (COICOP 01) y/y from Jan 2024, calculated by Asia Decoded (series food01: index Dec 2022 = 100 and y/y). DGBAS Macro Database via the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/tw/cpi/tw_cpi_dash.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each DGBAS release by the refresh scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals (main).
